name: 03_stretcher_carry_load
title: Stretcher carry and load
subtitle: Two G1s lift a pole stretcher by its end handles, carry it level to the ambulance, raise it to deck height and slide it in.

captions.text: The patient lies on a pole stretcher on the road shoulder, head toward the ambulance.
Each G1 stoops at one end and takes both handles.
On the count: both ends rise at the same rate, so the poles stay level.
The carry. B walks backward and A forward at the same pace; the stretcher stays level.
At the ambulance they raise the stretcher above deck height (0.80 m).
B is between the stretcher and the ambulance, so it moves to the side, sliding its left hand along the pole.
Together they walk the front legs over the deck.
The front legs rest on the deck. B lets go and steps clear; A slides the stretcher in.
